pr_title: Adding index path for apf debug endpoints
pr_body:
```release-note
NONE
```

the output will be like: 
```
kimmin-mpb:~ mbp$ curl -L -H 'Authorization: bearer 7b27df02-d21f-4420-844e-76050f1323bc' http://127.0.0.1:50100/debug/api_priority_and_fairness
{
  "paths": [
    "/debug/api_priority_and_fairness/dump_priority_levels",
    "/debug/api_priority_and_fairness/dump_queues",
    "/debug/api_priority_and_fairness/dump_requests"
  ]
}
```

fixes https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/93361

comments: Yeah our index page is not very smart.

FWIW, the current behavior is defined here: https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/e884b40e73c52227342e591ddf996cef262b3bd4/staging/src/k8s.io/apiserver/pkg/server/config.go#L660-L665

If the path is not handled, the apiserver always returns the index page.

Also note that some debug endpoints explicitly choose to not be included in the index page: https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/e884b40e73c52227342e591ddf996cef262b3bd4/staging/src/k8s.io/apiserver/pkg/server/routes/profiling.go#L31-L35

/unassign

> Also note that some debug endpoints explicitly choose to not be included in the index page:

it makes sense to me hiding the debugging endpoints from users in the root index, but what @MikeSpreitzer purposing is to list the existing paths under `/debug` prefix. obviously the users already knows the existence of debugging endpoints when they're looking for `/debug`, so it's probably not a good idea to make the endpoints completely invisible from users..

>   "/livez",
    "/livez/etcd",
    "/livez/log",
    "/livez/ping",
    "/livez/poststarthook/crd-informer-synced",
    "/livez/poststarthook/generic-apiserver-start-informers",
    "/livez/poststarthook/priority-and-fairness-config-consumer",
    "/livez/poststarthook/start-apiextensions-controllers",
    "/livez/poststarthook/start-apiextensions-informers",

btw if we're providing index for subpaths, for a lower verbosity, we should consider to merge the above pathes into:

>  "/livez"
    "/livez/",
